parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: • Adjusted EBITDA of $153 million, down 26 percent versus Q2 2025

parsed.notes: Only the Q2 2026 figure is stated in the excerpt; the prior-year Q2 2025 amount is not printed (only a 26% decline is given). No reconciliation table or year-to-date total is included. The full-year 2026 outlook range ($620–$680 million) is guidance, not a reported result, and is excluded.
